review.notes: All 23 physical pages compared against extracted PDF text; physical page 21 (Table 8) rendered at 110 dpi and visually verified against the printed criteria values and group headers. Tables 1-7, the reference list (physical p.1 arXiv stamp aside) and Figures 1-12 captions are present; the large unmatched fractions on physical pages 8, 15, 17 and 19 come from tables whose PDF text layer prints one value per line, and from figure-internal labels; the corresponding md tables (Dataset Statistics, LAPA dataset, RoboCasa Table 4, GR1/Franka/SO-100 results, IF correlation Tables 6-7) were spot-checked value-by-value against the text layer and match. One defect class fixed on physical page 21: Table 8's printed multi-line criteria cells were emitted with glued score boundaries (e.g. 'grasp handle0.66'), and the printed group headers 'Seen Environments, Novel Behaviors' and 'Novel Environments' were missing.
